line: A heavy glass globe set down on stone, heavy and short, then a wooden creak and a low eerie tone
why: the set-down that lies under all four landings (land-winter's takes 3 and 2), 120 cents lower for fall, its glass set back; when the knock has died, the wooden creak of the cue's own take 3; under the creak one made low tone that wavers, quiet support
